pr_title: Fix discovery schema for Matter switches
pr_body:

Fix the discovery schema of the Matter switch platform, we were only discovering power plugs and missed the switch/relay device types.

issue_context.body: ### The problem Hi guys. Im trying to add my Matter Wi-Fi Relay with 2 gangs, but when I add it into HomeAssistant, I don't have any entity! I tested this same relay on HomeKit and Smartthings with no problems. ### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue? core-2023.11.1 ### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core? core-2023.11.1 ### What type of installation are you running? Home Assistant OS ### Integration causing the issue Matter ### Link to integration documentation on our website _No response_ ### Diagnostics information [config_entry-matter-b9fb5d6a6e44ad0c20b52a4ee8e425fb.json.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/13314754/config_entry-matter-b9fb5d6a6e44ad0c20b52a4ee8e425fb.json.txt) ### Example YAML snippet _No response_ ### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us? _No response_ ### Additional information _No response_
